description: This file defines the PartialEmployee data transfer object (DTO) class used for representing partial employee data such as employee ID and work email. It includes getter and setter methods and a static method to create an instance from an Employee entity.

classes.name: PartialEmployee
classes.description: A DTO class that holds partial information about an employee, specifically employee ID and work email, with methods to get/set these properties and create a new instance from an Employee entity.

methods.name: getEmployeeId
methods.description: Returns the employee ID stored in the object.

methods.name: setEmployeeId
methods.description: Sets the employee ID and returns the instance for method chaining.

methods.name: getWorkEmail
methods.description: Returns the work email of the employee stored in the object.

methods.name: setWorkEmail
methods.description: Sets the work email and returns the instance for method chaining.

methods.name: createFromEmployee
methods.description: Creates a new PartialEmployee instance populated with data from an Employee entity.
